title: ShotSpace – Smart Screenshots
description:
📸 ShotSpace – Your Screenshot Manager & Search Hub

Screenshots are memories, receipts, tickets, ideas, conversations, and proof — but they quickly turn into chaos.  
ShotSpace turns your messy screenshot gallery into a clean, searchable, and organized space.

It’s not just a gallery.  
It’s a smart screenshot manager built to help you find anything in seconds.

🔍 Find Anything Inside Your Screenshots  
Ever taken a screenshot of a payment, OTP, booking, chat, address, product, or receipt — and later couldn’t find it?  
ShotSpace lets you search by the text inside your screenshots. Just type what you remember and it shows the right image instantly.

Type things like:  
Amazon  
₹1499  
Flight  
OTP  
Uber  

…and the screenshot appears.

🗂️ Organize Without Duplicating  
ShotSpace uses a link-based folder system.  
A screenshot can belong to multiple folders without being copied, so your phone storage stays clean.

Create folders like:  
Receipts  
Travel  
Work  
Shopping  
Bank  
IDs  

and add screenshots with one tap.

🏷️ Tags That Actually Help  
Add tags like:  
tax  
important  
refund  
client  
hotel  

Tags make filtering and searching even faster.

⚡ Smart Suggestions  
ShotSpace scans screenshots in the background and suggests folders and tags.  
Nothing is auto-moved — you stay in control.

📁 Unsorted → Organized  
New screenshots appear in Unsorted.  
From there you can add folders, tags, or let ShotSpace suggest where it belongs.

🔎 One Search for Everything  
Search across:  
• Screenshot text  
• Folder names  
• Tag names  

and jump straight to what you need.

🎨 Clean, Modern Design  
ShotSpace is designed to be calm, elegant, and visual — built around your screenshots.

🔐 100% Private  
Everything stays on your device.  
No uploads. No tracking. No cloud.

Perfect for:  
Receipts, bills, travel tickets, bank proofs, chat messages, work notes, and anything you screenshot.

ShotSpace doesn’t just store screenshots — it makes them useful again.
